proposed_evolution.from: a wheel is built from the working tree; the digest is a receipt of whatever the checkout happened to be
proposed_evolution.to: a wheel is built from a NAMED COMMIT through a tool that disables the checkout's line-ending rewrite and pins the archive timestamp; the build is a function of (commit, builder)
proposed_evolution.evidence: two independent builds of a6bcdd0 -> identical wheel sha256 a161162f... and identical sdist sha256 b147f674...
proposed_evolution.rule: A build that is not a function of its source cannot be a release artifact. Export from the object store, not from the disk.

proposed_evolution.from: assuming setuptools honours SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH for every artifact
proposed_evolution.to: setuptools honours it for the WHEEL only; the sdist carries 21 member mtimes and a wall-clock gzip header and must be repacked explicitly
proposed_evolution.evidence: measured on a6bcdd0: gzip header mtime bytes[4:8] were non-zero and 21 distinct member mtimes were present
proposed_evolution.rule: Verify reproducibility per ARTIFACT, not per build system. A wheel that is reproducible says nothing about the sdist next to it.

proposed_evolution.from: assigning member.mtime and expecting the header to follow
proposed_evolution.to: PAX_FORMAT keeps a sub-second mtime in pax_headers; create_pax_header only OVERWRITES it when the value does not fit the ustar field, so an integer epoch survives and the original float is still emitted
proposed_evolution.evidence: the first normalise_sdist attempt left 20 non-constant mtimes; the fix strips the pax 'mtime' key explicitly
proposed_evolution.rule: When normalising an archive, strip the extended header, do not just overwrite the field.

proposed_evolution.from: treating a filed defect as a permanent property of the platform
proposed_evolution.to: classify every open item by whether the missing thing is a HUMAN AUTHORITY, a HOST/NATIVE EFFECT, a NEW BUILD SLICE, or a DEFECT IN OUR OWN INPUTS - the last one is fixable now
proposed_evolution.evidence: TT-R6-WHEEL-NONREPRODUCIBLE-001 was filed as an open defect; the root cause was in our own build inputs, so it closed instead of being re-declared
proposed_evolution.rule: Before deferring a residual, ask who is missing: a person, a host, a build slice, or us. 'Us' is not a deferral reason.

proposed_evolution.from: a dispatch receipt without a nonce in the prompt
proposed_evolution.to: the nonce must be carried by the PROMPT and must appear in an ASSISTANT message; a prompt that does not carry it fails with ERR_NO_ARM_EMITTED_NONCE even when the arm served correctly
proposed_evolution.evidence: the first R7 lane probe returned ERR_NO_ARM_EMITTED_NONCE with exit 0 and a good usage row; adding the nonce to the prompt turned all three lanes ok
proposed_evolution.rule: A nonce proves the model answered only if the model was asked to say it. The prompt carries the nonce, not just the flag.

proposed_evolution.from: trusting the admission API's return value
proposed_evolution.to: read the chain back: the API returned a workorder id while the TaskSpec was still DRAFT and no WorkOrder existed, because _repo_head() reads the CALLER's cwd and returned '' outside a repo, so create_workorder raised InvariantViolation and the except swallowed it
proposed_evolution.evidence: REQ-HGK-PRJ-SBL-PIPDLS-R7-FARCLO readback showed TS state=DRAFT and a missing workorder; completing it through the public create_workorder API from a repo cwd produced the full chain
proposed_evolution.rule: An admission that returns an id is not an admission. Read the three rows back.

proposed_evolution.from: reviewing branches one at a time
proposed_evolution.to: measure all of them mechanically - merge-base, ahead/behind, diff --stat, merge-tree exit code, patch-equivalence - then classify; 49 branches collapse to exactly 1 MERGE_NOW
proposed_evolution.evidence: CANDIDATE_BRANCH_RULING.md: MERGE_NOW 1, SUPERSEDED 26, EVIDENCE_ONLY 16, NOT_RECOMMENDED 3, DO_NOT_MERGE 3
proposed_evolution.rule: A branch review that is not a measurement is an opinion. merge-tree exit code is the conflict answer.

note: Every rule was extracted from a failure that actually happened in this round, with the measurement that produced it.
